mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which can stimulate economic activity and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are not higher than baseline during periods of declining FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests labor market weakness, potentially leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases but 20-day returns remain positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth indicates reduced economic activity, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth slows but 60-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment and decreases in payroll employment signal labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls but 20-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production suggests supply chain issues, potentially leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines but 60-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% but 20-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPI) coupled with higher federal funds rates may lead to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise but 60-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts indicates reduced demand in the housing market, potentially leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases but 20-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time.
